definitions.explanation: A formal expression of apology that literally means 'there is no excuse.' Used to convey sincere remorse or regret for causing inconvenience or trouble to someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{迷惑|めいわく}→ご迷惑：28069_gomeiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧おかけ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ありません：21409_moushiwakearimasen⟧。
⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧しまい、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}なく⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: I am truly sorry for being late.

notes:
One of the most important apologetic expressions in Japanese, more formal than すみません and much more formal than ごめん. Literally means "there is no excuse" — the speaker acknowledges there is nothing they can say to justify what happened.

COMMON FORMS:
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ない: plain form (casual)
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ないです: polite form
- ⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ありません：21409_moushiwakearimasen⟧: formal polite
- ⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません→申し訳ございません：18087_moushiwakegozaimasen⟧: very formal/humble (business, customer service)
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}なく⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧: to feel sorry

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ない: sorry for doing ~
- ～⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ない: sorry about ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すみません: general-purpose apology, lighter and more versatile
- ⟦ごめんなさい→ごめんなさい：00931_gomennasai⟧: casual apology to someone of equal or lower status
- ⟦{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}ります→恐れ入る：05914_osoreiru⟧: humble expression closer to "I'm afraid" or "excuse me" than a direct apology

USAGE:
Also written {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ない as one compound. Often used in business settings and customer service. Can also be used as a set phrase when declining something: ⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ありません：21409_moushiwakearimasen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧... (I'm sorry, but...).
